overall_summary: The channel heavily indexes on 'self respect' with micro-actions related to phones and chats (e.g., pinning, muting, deleting). Performance is universally low across all uploads (mostly under 50 views), indicating low algorithmic traction or early-stage reach, though topics centered on concrete digital actions (like deleting status lists or unpinning chats) slightly edge out abstract overthinking.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Self Respect: Why I finally muted that pinned chat' (21 views), 'چैट डिलीट करने की हिम्मत' (41 views), and status list clearing (41 views) perform relatively better than abstract late-night thoughts.
winning_patterns.action: Focus hooks on tangible, modern smartphone rituals related to parting ways or reclaiming personal space.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'रात के दो बजे' (13 views) and 'मेज पर रखी चाय ठंडी हो गई' (6 views) have lower engagement.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid generic atmospheric clichés like cold tea or 2 AM clocks unless tied to a specific, unique real-life interaction.
